name: smart-training
description: MVP educativo de capacitaciones corporativas basadas en video

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:5175: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5175 --strictPort"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend run test -- validators.test.ts training-service.test.ts json-store.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix backend run test -- content.test.ts video.test.ts health.test.ts documentation.test.ts
scripts.test:security: npm --prefix backend run test -- auth.test.ts authorization.test.ts users.test.ts validators.test.ts
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run docs:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.predeploy:core: npm run verify && npm run test:contract && npm run test:security && npm run test:properties && npm run test:e2e && npm run audit:prod
